name: Arsen MCP
tagline: Explore social-engineering simulation results and awareness-training data.
description: Connect Cline to Arsen's hosted MCP server to query simulation results and awareness-training data available to your Arsen account. Uses Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in and requires an Arsen account with organization access.

install.notes: Complete Arsen OAuth sign-in when prompted. An Arsen account with organization access is required.
